frontier.hypothesis: reload1.c's reload/inheritance copy emission is the last unmeasured producer in the completed census, and is the only remaining pass that could create target's preheader copy addu $a3,$a0,$zero at 0x800178D0 without a source-level copy statement.
frontier.mechanism: reload1.c holds 13 emit_move_insn/gen_move_insn sites (emit_reload_insns and the inheritance paths). scan_hand_coded reports 7 spills in the 127-insn target (s27, E-s27-5), so a reload situation is not a priori absent - but a reload copy is normally reg-to-stack or stack-to-reg, and the copy at 0x800178D0 is pseudo-to-pseudo with no stack slot in sight.
frontier.next_probe: Read reload1.c's 13 sites end to end and identify which, if any, can emit a REGISTER-to-REGISTER reload copy with no memory operand. If one exists, characterise the reload class/conflict that triggers it and check the .greg/.lreg dumps of the standing candidate for that conflict at the loop-2 preheader; only if the conflict is reproducible does a C spelling become worth pricing.

frontier.hypothesis: Target's preheader copy is not created by any optimisation pass at all - it is an ordinary expand-time copy from a source-level assignment, the same construct the candidate's `p = q` buys for loop 1, and the residual is purely the price of siting a second one for loop 2.
frontier.mechanism: E-s28-1 closes the producer census; E-s28-2/3 kill the one new pass-level candidate by measurement; E-s28-4 excludes loop.c. If reload1.c also falls, no pass remains, and the copy must be present in the RTL before any optimisation - i.e. it came from C.
frontier.next_probe: Conditional on the reload1.c reading above coming back negative. Then the search returns to siting a second-use carrier for loop 2's pointer at a price below 6, which the banked price table (post-loop 19-22, in-body 6, pre-join 12, guard-consuming 6-28) says has no measured site - so the productive move would be to look for a site that does not appear in that table at all, e.g. a use inside the loop-2 guard's own arm rather than in its condition.
